title: Pro Shop Store Credit: post-reinstatement top-up reversal window
content:
## Applies to
Pro Shop Store Credit: this document covers how much of a member's recent top-up activity is reversed once a suspended account is reinstated, for every tier of this product.

## Basis
As a fraud-prevention safeguard, once a suspended Pro Shop Store Credit account is reinstated back to active status, every top-up recorded within the calendar month immediately preceding that reinstatement is reversed. The amount reversed is the tier's own refund percentage applied to the total dollar amount those top-ups credited within that one-month look-back window, added together across every such top-up before the percentage is applied. The figure this produces before rounding is then rounded to two decimal places.

## Points of judgement
This reversal runs automatically upon reinstatement; the member need not request it. Only top-ups recorded within the one calendar month immediately before the reinstatement are counted toward this reversal -- a top-up recorded earlier than that one-month window is not included in the total this reversal reverses.
